name: teraswitch Seoul Data Center
notes: Directory listing places teraswitch Seoul Data Center at Seoul Sky, Olympic-ro, Songpa-gu. Capacity/operator details not independently verified from a primary source; no other datacenter activity found in Songpa-gu.

name: KT Mokdong IDC 1
notes: KT Mokdong IDC 1 at 924-4 Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, established 2008, ~65,000 sqm, ~40,000 kW (40 MW) utility supply capacity per KT/IDC brochure sources; ZDNet feature confirms Mokdong as a KT cloud/IDC hub. IT load not separately disclosed.

name: KT Mokdong IDC 2
notes: KT Mokdong IDC 2 at 918-1 Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, 50,318 sqm GFA; KT Cloud launched its AI Data Center Demonstration Center at Mok-dong DC 2 in November 2025 (DCD).

name: KDT IDC Mokdong Data Center (DC2)
notes: KDT IDC official centers page lists DC2 Mokdong Data Center inside KT ICC, Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, carrier-neutral colocation with 400G backbone and DDoS protection.

name: KT Yeouido IDC / KT Yeouido DC
notes: KT Yeouido IDC at 14 Yeoui-daero, Yeongdeungpo-gu; described as the only commercial data center in Yeouido (dedicated financial/security tenant per OCOLO). Capacity not found.

name: KT Cloud Yeouido Data Center expansion (financial DC)
notes: KT Cloud started expansion construction of its financial-specialized Yeouido Data Center on 10 Jul 2026 to build a next-generation financial infrastructure hub near the Korea Exchange; capacity not disclosed.

name: Actis / Epoch Digital Yangpyeong Data Centre
notes: Seoul Property Insight reported Actis began operating the DITO Yangpyeong Center (Yangpyeong-dong, Yeongdeungpo-gu) at 26 MW; C&W 1H2024 listed the same project at 26 MW while under construction.

name: Okestro Yeouido Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists Okestro Yeouido at 108 Yeoui-daero; Baxtel describes Okestro/DC Korea's Yeouido sovereign AI data center as ~5 MW. Directory-derived, weak evidence.

name: KT DX IDC Yongsan
notes: KT completed and began full operation of KT DX IDC Yongsan on 5 Nov 2020 - KT's 13th IDC and then Seoul area's largest (48,000 sqm, 7 above/6 below floors, ~100,000 servers, 100Gbps single-ring service); positioned as AI data center.

name: SK AI Data Center Ulsan (SK-AWS, Hwangseong-dong)
developer: SK Telecom / SK Ecoplant with AWS and Ulsan City
notes: SK Telecom and SK Ecoplant held the groundbreaking ceremony for SK AI Data Center Ulsan on 29 Aug 2025 with AWS and Ulsan City; 36,000 sqm site in Hwangseong-dong, Nam-gu (Ulsan Mipo National Industrial Complex), 103 MW total, ~60,000 GPUs, ~KRW 7tn investment. 40 MW phase 1 operational by Nov 2027, full 103 MW by Feb 2029; AWS to tenant 40 MW (60,000 GPUs) 'AWS AI Zone'; SK Group plans expansion toward 1 GW (SKT official newsroom + Asiae + News1 construction progress reporting).

name: KIOST Ulsan Underwater Data Center Complex / Sinri Port testbed
developer: Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology; Ulsan Metropolitan City; GS E&C; POSCO
notes: KIOST, Ulsan City, GS E&C and POSCO are developing an eco-friendly underwater data center complex targeting 100,000 servers; first underwater module testbed planned ~30 m below sea level off Sinri Port, Seosaeng-myeon, Ulju-gun, with 2027 installation target per 2025 reporting.
